decision.conclusion: The registry multiplicity values are retained and interpreted as symmetry-distinct Ugi amine sites. This admits A5 without an identity exception and reconstructs all 1,200 measured products.

multiplicity_policy.atom_equivalence_method: RDKit canonical atom symmetry ranks with breakTies=false
multiplicity_policy.selectivity_policy: Acid-free Ugi three-component condensation forming an alpha-amino amide: an N-H amine and an aldehyde condense to an imine, an isocyanide adds, and hydration yields R1-NH-CH(R2)-C(=O)-NH-R4. Reactive handles: an amine with at least one N-H (primary or secondary; tertiary amines are inert), an aldehyde carbon bearing exactly one H (ketones are inert), and a terminal (degree-1) isocyanide carbon (internal nitrile carbons are inert). Substrates with multiple N-H amines enumerate one alpha-amino-amide regiochemical product per reactive amine; all are route-certified and deduplicated downstream.

agile_head_procurement_snapshot_audit.identity_policy: A record must match the exact campaign head by canonical constitutional identity and the neutral free-base form. Name-only, salt-only, and close-analogue matches do not qualify.
agile_head_procurement_snapshot_audit.price_policy: Prices are intentionally excluded because they are volatile and are not evidence of chemical identity or availability.
